summary: Frozen CPU synthetic compatibility gate accepted all five orthogonal-safe adapter pairs and rejected all five policy-conflicting pairs without threshold edits. This supports the narrow proposition that a preregistered gate can separate these two constructed classes. It does not establish general compatibility detection.
hostile_challenge: Current component-projection gate may falsely reject a valid additive pair whose adapters overlap the same output/latent direction. Orthogonal-safe versus opposite-conflict is too easy a separation problem.
